full_description:
I need an experienced marketer to attract a steady stream of qualified prospects to my credit-repair service. The sole focus is lead generation, so every tactic you propose should point back to filling my pipeline with people who genuinely need credit help.

Here’s the toolbox I want to lean on: Facebook for its detailed interest targeting, Google Ads for high-intent search traffic, and LinkedIn for professional audiences who may require credit improvement before major financing decisions. If you see a smart way to blend these platforms—retarget Facebook traffic with Google Display, for instance—detail that in your plan.

What I expect from you:
• Strategy outline explaining how each platform will contribute to lead volume and cost efficiency. 
• Full campaign build-out (ad copy, creative, and audience segmentation). 
• Tracking set-up—pixels, UTM parameters, conversion events—so we know exactly which ads pull in the best prospects. 
• Ongoing optimisation: split-testing, bid adjustments, and audience refinement at least once a week. 
• Simple weekly report summarising spend, CPL, lead quality, and next-step recommendations.

Leads will be captured through my existing CRM; I’ll share access once we start. Please include examples of similar campaigns you’ve run, the tools you rely on (e.g., Facebook Ads Manager, Google Ads Editor, LinkedIn Campaign Manager), and a quick snapshot of the results you achieved. I’m ready to move quickly once I find the right fit.

I am Amit Sharma, a Mechanical Design Engineer with eleven years at Yogiji Digi, where I lead projects ranging from complete rolling-mill lines and colour-coating plants to specialised jig and fixture systems. A steady flow of new work means I now need an experienced freelancer who can jump in and handle end-to-end mechanical design tasks rather than a single niche. 

You will be modelling, detailing and refining components for rolling-mill equipment, production jigs, fixtures and occasional tool-room assemblies, all in native SolidWorks. Good design intent, manufacturability awareness and clear communication are essential. 

Please focus your bid on the depth and relevance of your experience—examples of past SolidWorks projects that prove you can take a concept through to fully toleranced drawings will make your proposal stand out. 

Key deliverables for each assignment will typically include: 
• SolidWorks part and assembly files 
• Fully dimensioned 2D manufacturing drawings with tolerances and fits

full_description:
We are seeking to identify two new international export markets for our premium range of wood-burning appliances. The products are manufactured in India and exported to each target market.

The objective is to identify markets that offer the best long-term commercial opportunity based on demand, market accessibility, and profitability.

Market Selection Criteria

Please identify two countries that meet the following criteria:
• A strong and established wood-burning culture, where wood burners are commonly used for home heating.
• An affluent consumer base with sufficient disposable income to purchase premium wood-burning appliances.
• A climate that supports regular use of wood heating.
• Stable economic and political conditions.
• A growing or sustainable market for premium heating products.
• Regulations that permit the sale of modern, clean-burning wood burners.

Trade & Commercial Assessment

As the products are manufactured in India, please assess each market for:
• Import duties and tariff rates on wood-burning appliances.
• Any Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) or preferential trade arrangements with India that reduce or eliminate import duties.
• Import taxes (VAT/GST) and other government charges.
• Customs and import requirements.
• Ease of importing products from India.
• Typical shipping routes, transit times, and any major logistical considerations.
• Any known trade barriers or restrictions.

Market Analysis

For each recommended country, please provide:
1. Why the country is a strong fit for our products.
2. Estimated market size and annual demand for wood-burning appliances.
3. Consumer demographics and purchasing power.
4. Key competitors and leading brands.
5. Typical retail pricing for premium wood burners.
6. Distribution channels, including major importers, distributors, fireplace specialists, and retail chains.
7. Product certification, emissions, safety standards, and any testing or approval requirements before products can be sold.
8. Local building regulations or environmental policies that may affect wood burner sales.
9. Opportunities and potential risks.
10. An overall assessment of the market's attractiveness.

Final Recommendation

Please conclude with:
• A comparison of the two recommended markets.
• A ranking of the markets based on overall commercial potential.
• Expected ease of market entry.
• Estimated time and investment required to establish distribution.
• Your recommendation on which market should be prioritised first and why. 

The objective of this research is to identify export markets that provide the best combination of strong demand, premium pricing potential, favourable trade conditions with India, and long-term growth opportunities.
